messages:
Sam: Heads up—planning an RFC review block on Tue. 4 RFCs: storage-eviction-policy, observability-unified-metrics, model-routing, rollout-safety. Need slotting + reviewers. Who's available? :wave:

Priya: I'm author for storage-eviction-policy. Prefer morning PT. Will drop pre-read shortly.

Marta: Author for observability-unified-metrics. CEST afternoon preferred but can move if it's important.

Diego: I can review Priya + Marta. Morning PT ok but hard stop 11:30 PT. Will focus on metrics ingestion for Marta.

Arun: I'll take reviews for model-routing and rollout-safety. Need contiguous block to focus. Flexible otherwise.

Jin: Out Tue morning PT. Available after 14:00 PT. Can swap with Diego if necessary. Happy to scribe Slot B.

Sam: Proposal: compress into two back-to-back slots to reduce context switching: Slot A 45m for Priya + Marta, Slot B 30m for model-routing + rollout-safety. Agree?

Priya: Pre-read: https://files.redwood/rfcs/storage-eviction-policy.md — focus on perf table and rollback plan. TL;DR at top.

Marta: If Slot A is morning I can move. Diego, can you commit to reviewing metrics ingestion assumptions? :pray:

Diego: Yes. If Slot A is 09:00–09:45 PT I can cover both until my 11:30 hard stop.

Sam: Quick react poll: :one: 09:00 PT, :two: 10:30 PT, :three: 13:00 PT. I'll lock calendar on majority.

Arun: :one:

Jin: :three:

Priya: :one:

Marta: :one: (moved calendar) thanks Diego :thumbsup:

Sam: Majority :one: — locking Slot A 09:00–09:45 PT, Slot B 10:00–10:30 PT. Calendar invite coming with pre-reads and scribe. calendar-bot please create event with Zoom + recording.

calendar-bot: Created event "RFC Review — compact slots" 2030460000. Zoom link & recording enabled. Invites sent.

Diego: Draft Slot A agenda:
```
9:00–9:05 intro & goals
9:05–9:25 Priya — storage-eviction-policy (Q&A)
9:25–9:45 Marta — observability-unified-metrics (Q&A)
```

Arun: Slot B fine. Add 5m at end for action items & rollbacks.

Sam: Will post 1-paragraph pre-read checklist in #eng for folks who haven't read. If anyone was assigned as reviewer and can't make it, ping me ASAP to reassign.

Priya: Thanks — I'll add a one-line 'what to focus on' in the doc header.

Marta: I'll highlight the ingestion assumptions section and add a test plan link.

Jin: I'll scribe Slot B and capture action items. See you all.
